facts.fact: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci in the early sixteenth century.
The movable-type printing press was invented by Johannes Gutenberg around 1440.
Shakespeare wrote plays and poetry in England in the late sixteenth and early seventeenth century.
Picasso co-founded Cubism; Impressionism was led by Monet and Renoir in the 1870s.
Napoleon Bonaparte was Emperor of the French, not of Russia.
The Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from the Moon.
In music, major scales typically sound bright and minor scales sound melancholic.
Beethoven was profoundly deaf when he completed his Ninth Symphony in 1824.
Beethoven composed classical music; he did not paint.
